spoken_aliases: the sum from n equals one to infinity of one over n squared equals pi squared over six
the sum from n equals one to infinity of one divided by n squared equals pi squared divided by six

evidence: The series converges by the integral comparison with 1/x^2. NIST DLMF 25.2.1 identifies its sum with zeta(2) because Re(2)>1; DLMF 25.6.1 gives zeta(2)=pi^2/6. This is an exact reference-based verification, not a new proof of the zeta evaluation.
Reference cross-check: https://dlmf.nist.gov/25.2.E1; https://dlmf.nist.gov/25.6.E1. Checked 2026-11-27. Proposed maintainer approval; not independent human certification.
